name: Baserow
description: No-code database and app builder, an Airtable alternative

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything: the built-in PostgreSQL database, uploaded files, and the secret keys Baserow makes on first start (.secret, .jwt_signing_key, .pgpass). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Baserow web UI and API, published on host as 6766

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASEROW_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6766. Your browser talks to Baserow at this address. For a domain use https://tables.example.com.
